name: Constant duty operation
condition: Stable temperature, clean medium, continuous operation on a fixed duty point.
criteria: Range chosen at 1.5x the working value.
Output matched to the control input.
IP rating matched to indoor installation.
Record the duty point on the drawing so a later replacement is sized the same way.
cautions: Do not size the range at the working value exactly.
Recheck accuracy after a medium change.
A range that fits today can be too tight after a process change; leave margin.
seoDescription: Constant duty operation: how to size the range, match the output and pick the right IP rating for a fixed duty point.The checklist is written for field use.

zh.name: 恒定工况运行
zh.condition: 温度稳定、介质洁净、长期运行在固定工况点。
criteria: 量程按工作值的 1.5 倍选取。
输出信号与控制系统输入匹配。
防护等级按室内安装选择。
把工况点标在图纸上，后续替换按同一口径选型。
cautions: 不要按工作值上限精确选取量程。
更换介质后需复核精度。
今天合适的量程，工艺变更后可能就偏紧，需留余量。
zh.seoTitle: 恒定工况运行：量程、输出与防护等级怎么定
zh.seoDescription: 恒定工况下的选型顺序：先按工作值确定量程并留出余量，再核对输出与控制系统匹配，最后按安装位置确定防护等级，避免量程选窄导致早期失效。所有参数以型号页标注为准。
